verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is a code-first library where agent construction, tools, handoffs, and running are all done via Python/JS code by design — there is no separate feature-rich UI whose capabilities the API must match. The only UI-like element mentioned (the Traces dashboard) is a secondary observability view over trace data generated by the SDK itself, not a primary interface for building agents, so a UI/API parity comparison is a category mismatch for this product type.
